Hi all,

I'm having trouble with the part 5. I managed to run the code a few times before, but for some reason it stopped working. The code runs normally until part 4 and after that it generates the following error: 

Error in eval(parse(text = paste0("spo_day", k))) :

So in result, I get folders with the milestones but an empty results folder. Has anyone had this before?


Thanks,

General advise: When you ask a question in this group always try to create a minimalistic example that someone else can use to reproduce and investigate your problem. Instructions on how to ask good questions on open source software can be found elsewhere:
https://stackoverflow.com/help/how-to-ask or https://www.biostars.org/p/75548/

Common reasons for problems that can easily be addressed:
- Check that you do not mix up GGIR output from different GGIR versions.
- Restart R after updating a package, which is quite often the reason for problems.
- When GGIR has recently been updated then be aware that the new version for Windows may give errors during installation.
- Inspect output from GGIR part 2 about measurement duration and quality when you run into issues with part 4 or 5. Often the part 2 output can give a hint about why there might be a problem. For example, the measurement was too short or the sensor was not worn at all.

Following the above, would you be able to share a small subset of the output folder in order to facilitate reproduction of your error?
